subject: general
question: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has been upgraded to which status by the Ministry of Finance in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharatna CPSE**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) has been upgraded to the status of **Maharatna Central Public Sector Enterprise (CPSE)** by the Ministry of Finance in 2024.
 
• The Maharatna status is one of the highest recognitions given to Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) in India.
 
• This status provides HAL with greater autonomy and financial powers, enabling it to undertake larger investments and enhance its operational efficiency.
 
• HAL is a premier aerospace and defense company in India, playing a crucial role in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of aircraft and helicopters.
 
• With Maharatna status, HAL can now invest up to 15% of its net worth in a single project without government approval.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maharatna CPSE**

 
 
• The Maharatna status is granted to select CPSEs to enhance their financial and operational autonomy.
 
• To qualify for Maharatna status, a CPSE must have a minimum annual turnover of Rs. 25,000 crore, net worth of Rs. 15,000 crore, and net profit of Rs. 5,000 crore for three consecutive years.
 
• Maharatna companies can form joint ventures and subsidiaries, and enter into technology collaborations without government approval.
 
 
 
• **Navratna CPSE**
 
 
• Navratna status is a recognition given to CPSEs that show operational efficiency and profitability.
 
• Navratna companies have greater operational autonomy compared to Mini Ratna companies, but less than Maharatna companies.
 
• Navratna companies can invest up to Rs. 1,000 crore without government approval.
 
 
 
• **Mini Ratna CPSE**
 
 
• Mini Ratna status is granted to relatively smaller CPSEs that have shown consistent profitability and operational efficiency.
 
• There are two categories of Mini Ratna: Category I and Category II, with Category I having higher financial autonomy.
 
• Mini Ratna companies can invest up to Rs. 500 crore or an amount equal to their net worth, whichever is lower, without government approval.
 
 
 
• **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)**
 
 
• HAL was established in 1940 and is headquartered in Bangalore, India.
 
• The company is involved in the design, manufacture, and maintenance of aircraft, helicopters, and their engines.
 
• HAL plays a crucial role in India's defense sector and has partnerships with several international aerospace companies.
